description: An array literal is a value in hand exactly as an object literal is, so a path walked through one reaches `Array.prototype` and the baseline answers for it: `indexOf` discharges the condition and `join` fails it. A `const` bound to the literal is the same value, reached one hop further. The last call is the boundary: a binding merely *typed* `readonly string[]` is a supertype's promise a subclass can override, so it floors as before.
